title: hieracium neolygodes
intro: Hieracium neolygodes, commonly known as the Hawkweed plant, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. The health benefits of Hieracium neolygodes include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, digestive issues, and inflammation, likely due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids have been identified in Hieracium neolygodes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
